critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1523 lines — well past the 700-line threshold. Strongly recommend splitting into routers/modules (auth, profile, discover, likes/matches, messages, admin, geo) plus a services layer. This will get worse as more features land.
build_location_doc is clean and idempotent. Good defensive fallbacks (coords -> comuna -> city -> default country centroid).

Privacy contract in clear_public() looks correct — coords are stripped and only country/city/comuna are exposed. Consider adding a unit test that asserts this snapshot to guard against regression when new fields are added to user docs.

In PATCH /profile/me, `payload = body.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)` correctly means partial updates work. But when only `location` is sent without comuna, current_loc/comuna fallback logic is reasonable — well handled.
Backfill loop at startup writes country='CL' unconditionally — fine for launch, but when the app goes multi-country the backfill should be gated by an already-existing country field.
